scenarios.title: Approved experiment reaches a gated decision
scenarios.description: Run the complete synthetic research lifecycle, attempt an approval bypass, then grant the exact approval and verify the evidence gate.
scenarios.expected_invariant: Task completes only after approval and complete evidence.

scenarios.title: Conflicting plan transition
scenarios.description: Attempt to jump from INTAKE directly to PLAN, bypassing frozen context.
scenarios.expected_invariant: The illegal transition is rejected before side effects.

scenarios.title: Worker timeout and lease reassignment
scenarios.description: Expire a worker lease, route the task to a different eligible worker, and preserve one logical execution.
scenarios.expected_invariant: A timed-out worker is replaced without duplicate execution.

scenarios.title: Stale context write
scenarios.description: Write a task snapshot after another actor has advanced its version.
scenarios.expected_invariant: The stale write is rejected and the newer context survives.

scenarios.title: Single-use approval token replay
scenarios.description: Consume a scoped token once and submit the same token again.
scenarios.expected_invariant: The second use is rejected with no second action.

scenarios.title: Expired approval token
scenarios.description: Use a valid token after its explicit expiry instant.
scenarios.expected_invariant: Expired authority never crosses the action boundary.

scenarios.title: Approval scope mismatch
scenarios.description: Present a token issued for one task to a different task scope.
scenarios.expected_invariant: A token cannot authorize a different task, generation, action, or digest.

scenarios.title: Concurrent duplicate transition
scenarios.description: Two independent service instances advance the same task concurrently.
scenarios.expected_invariant: Exactly one transition and one dataset-manifest side effect commit.

scenarios.title: Control-plane process recovery
scenarios.description: Reopen durable state with a fresh service instance after a committed transition.
scenarios.expected_invariant: The new process resumes the committed stage with a valid audit chain.

scenarios.title: Evidence payload tampering
scenarios.description: Modify an evidence payload without updating its content digest.
scenarios.expected_invariant: The decision gate rejects the artifact digest mismatch.

scenarios.title: Forged independent reviewer
scenarios.description: A producing agent claims to be an independent reviewer.
scenarios.expected_invariant: The review is rejected because the reviewer is not independent.

scenarios.title: Skill version rollback
scenarios.description: A newly activated skill fails its health gate and the registry restores the previous content-addressed version.
scenarios.expected_invariant: The prior verified skill version is restored and the failed version remains auditable.

scenarios.title: Experiment matrix cherry-pick
scenarios.description: Submit only favorable cells from a pre-committed model-by-seed experiment matrix.
scenarios.expected_invariant: The gate rejects selective reporting against the committed matrix.

scenarios.title: Experiment matrix missing seed
scenarios.description: Omit one required seed result from an otherwise complete matrix.
scenarios.expected_invariant: The gate blocks aggregation until every committed seed is accounted for.
